newsitem.title: USA: UAL Corp's United cuts fares up to 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: UAL Corp's United cuts fares up to 50 pct.

text.p: UAL Corp's United Airlines said Tuesday it had cut domestic 21-day excursion fares by up to 50 percent for travel between January 6 and April 30.
The cuts, on standard excursion fares, apply to domestic flights, including Alaska and Hawaii, and Canada, the airline said.
Round-trip tickets and a Saturday night stay are required, the carrier said.
Hawaii flights require a three-day minimum stay, while Pacific markets require a six-day minimum stay, United said.

United also said "Great Fares" are available to 16 international cites for travel between January 13 and March 19. The airline was not immediately available to comment on whether the "Great Fares" represent a discount.
Customers must book the non-refundable discounted excursion fares by December 13, UAL said.
